note: Both sets share significant errors, including a contradictory claim for the tower natural frequency (0.18 Hz vs text 0.170 Hz), an invented 'steady-state' condition, and duplicate claims for wave frequency and tower mode. Set A is better because its quotes are more faithful and complete (e.g., including 'in WISDEM and OpenFAST'), whereas Set B truncates quotes and invents text within a quote field ('[vertical line at ~0.17]').
